import primitive_api as api

ctx = api.get_task_context()
obs = api.inspect_current_view(label="start_view", remember=True)
scan = api.scan_scene(
    queries=["Watch", "TVStand", "Television", "Table", "SideTable", "CoffeeTable", "DiningTable", "CreditCard"],
    rotations=4,
    include_tilts=True,
    remember=True,
)
mem = api.recall_visible_objects(limit=50)
prog = api.check_progress_public()

print("CTX:", ctx)
print("INITIAL VISIBLE:", [o.get("objectType") + "|" + str(o.get("objectId")) + "|dist=" + str(o.get("distance")) for o in obs.get("visible_objects", [])])
print("SCAN HITS:", {k: [x.get("objectId") for x in v] for k, v in scan.get("query_hits", {}).items()})
print("MEMORY:", [(m.get("objectType"), m.get("objectId"), round(m.get("distance", -1), 2), m.get("pose")) for m in mem])
print("PROGRESS:", prog)

import primitive_api as api

# Look down to see the watches on the TV stand, pick one up, look back up, and put it on the SideTable with CreditCard
look_down_res = api.look("down")
vis_down = api.detect_objects("Watch")
print("VISIBLE WATCHES AFTER LOOK DOWN:", vis_down)

picked = False
if vis_down:
    # Sort by distance
    vis_down_sorted = sorted(vis_down, key=lambda o: o.get("distance", 999))
    for w in vis_down_sorted:
        res_pick = api.pickup_object(w["objectId"])
        print("PICKUP ATTEMPT:", w["objectId"], res_pick)
        if api.query_inventory():
            picked = True
            break

# Look back up to restore horizon
look_up_res = api.look("up")

if not picked:
    print("Direct look-down pickup failed, using pickup_located_object...")
    res_loc_pick = api.pickup_located_object("Watch", support_queries=["TVStand"], search_budget=16)
    print("LOCATE PICKUP:", res_loc_pick)

inv = api.query_inventory()
print("INVENTORY:", inv)

if inv:
    held_id = inv[0]["objectId"]
    # Check if SideTable|+02.00|+00.00|+01.75 is visible right now
    tables = api.detect_objects("SideTable")
    print("VISIBLE SIDETABLES:", tables)
    target_table = "SideTable|+02.00|+00.00|+01.75"
    put_res = None
    if any(t["objectId"] == target_table for t in tables):
        put_res = api.put_object(held_id, target_table)
        print("DIRECT PUT RESULT:", put_res)
    if not api.check_success().get("success"):
        # If still holding the watch, try place_held_object on the SideTable
        if api.query_inventory():
            place_res = api.place_held_object("SideTable|+02.00|+00.00|+01.75", aliases=["SideTable"], support_queries=["CreditCard"], search_budget=20)
            print("PLACE HELD RESULT:", place_res)

view_after = api.inspect_current_view(label="after_put", remember=True)
print("CHECK SUCCESS:", api.check_success())
print("PROGRESS:", api.check_progress_public())
